source.section: Exact finite counting bound equation(3), and counting proof

target_statement: For all natural L>=1 and r>=1, set J=(L/2-1)/r. The exact number of ALL positive ordinary canonical width-L integers with none of the J selected mirrored all-nine blocks is 9*10^(L-1-2*r*J)*(10^(2*r)-1)^J. Block j selects positions 1+j*r+i for i<r and their mirrors L-1-(1+j*r+i). Prove a complete duplicate-free numeric enumeration or equivalent filtered canonical interval count; a constructed subfamily count is insufficient. Specialize r=FiniteHorizonBlocks.blockLength R to obtain the direct finite early-hit count upper bound at positive times1..R+1 using existing mirroredNines_safe_prefix.
boundaries: Prove 2*r*J<=L-1 to justify the free-digit exponent
Odd/even widths; markers avoid both ends and the odd center
Leading digit1..9, all other digits0..9, trailing zero allowed
All canonical integers in [10^(L-1),10^L), complete and without duplicates
Early-hit implication uses positive times; no initial nonpalindrome restriction
